name: ui-focus-ring-draw
title: Border Draw
description: Nhấn Tab, một viền màu nhấn tự vẽ một vòng quanh nút từ giữa cạnh trên theo chiều kim đồng hồ, khép lại thì loé nhẹ ra ngoài.

moworks.author: takayu

options.draw: s (0.8, power2.inOut), clockwise from the top centre
options.dot: px radius of the drawing head (9)
options.cursor: an optional cursor that makes the clicks
options.approach: [x, y] px the cursor comes from
options.lead: s it arrives before a click

credit.author: TakayuStudio (motion-reference)
credit.licence: No licence stated: idea and numbers only
credit.madeNote: written here from the idea and its numbers; none of the source's code

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio catalog-ui-button-border-draw, written here): Button 140x44 r12 (dark fill, light label). Focus ring offset 5 px (150x54, r17), one 2.5 px accent stroke starting at the top centre, clockwise, 0 → 100 % of the perimeter over 0.45-1.25 s (800 ms) power2.inOut, a 4 px head dot while drawing. On closing a copy flashes outward 6 px and fades over 0.3 s. Out 2.25-2.5 s power2.in. Trigger: a Tab key cap pressed at 0.3-0.45 s. Params: offset (5 px) · draw (0.8 s, power2.inOut) · stroke (2.5 px) · flash (6 px, 0.3 s).
moworks.titleVi: Viền tiêu điểm tự vẽ quanh nút
